song: 32 - Daft Punk - Harder, Better, Faster, Stronger (Official Audio)
title: the crystal grows on the vocal chops and the kick shakes it
story: Harder Better Faster Stronger at 123 BPM (beat 15.62 ticks): the build is a run of vocal chops on the eighths (MID hits, centroid 0.15-0.25); the kick and the dark strokes shake the crystal, escalating each bar until the drop, and the luz glows up. At the drop (3187, rms 0.13->0.20) the crystal swells once (tam 1.0->1.5), the walkers rise, the spin flips, the contrast opens and the hue steps; the prominent hits (>11, 3336-3399 and 3585-3648) punch the crystal size and flash. After the drop the kick sets luz on every beat, the bright snares lift col_bri and shake, and the deriva direction turns every two bars while the hue sways per bar.
